title: Weaird-Renames
description: Add some anvil renames for Tools. Like renaming Diamond_Axe to "BlueCube" will turn it into a Blue Cube.
body:
![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qAuHjxvM/images/e4d43c0e60935fda6e2082048656a8866eab4365.gif)

This pack add some renames for Minecraft **Tools**.

Install this on your freinds minecraft to prank them.

Check **[Gallery](https://modrinth.com/project/qAuHjxvM/gallery)** for images.
<details>
<summary>For Version 1.0</summary>
  
## Renames:

Diamond_Axe to "BlueCube" to make it a Blue Cube.

Golden_Axe to "Jandel" to make it show the text "Jan.." (yes im too lazy to make the full).

Netherite_Axe to "Fist" to make it invisible. (good for pranking Right?)

Wooden_Hoe to "Date" to make it look like the fruit Date.

Wooden_Sword to "Cover" to make it a big Cuboid to cover you.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Extra</summary>

1. You can install [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) to have a useless settings that does nothing.

2. I made the **Logo** & **Cover** with https://www.textstudio.com/

3. if the pack doesnt work put it on top of the list.

</details>
